cases.title: Minnesota MMB February 2026 Budget Forecast
syuzhet_angles: They buried 3,670,799 in a budget forecast like it was hiding from rent. Goblin Court found it in four seconds and asked why the PDF was sweating.
General Fund Balance is government for: money exists, but somehow your problem still has to wait until the next committee meeting.
Hash 04368980… They signed it. We saved it. They cannot unsign the receipt.
The PDF brought pages. The goblin brought one line. Witness testimony: General Fund Balance 3 670 799. Courtroom gasps in monospace.
Same public record. Different goblin angle. Today’s accusation: the spreadsheet used formal formatting as camouflage and got caught wearing a tiny tie.
Line 47. General Fund Balance. 3,670,799. The forecast forgot you would find it.
